title: Smart Data Models - Drainage Pipe schema
description: A drainage pipe for wastewater and sanitation networks

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type: It has to be DrainagePipe

address.description: Property. Address associated with the building.

addressCountry.description: Property. Country in which the building is located.

addressLocality.description: Property. Locality, which must correspond to the municipality.

addressRegion.description: Property. NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located.

district.description: Property. Administrative district in which the locality is located.

postalCode.description: Property. Postal code of the address.

streetAddress.description: Property. Street address of the building.

streetNr.description: Property. Street number of the building.

alternateName.description: Property. Alternative name for the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

areaServed.description: Property. Geographic area where a service is provided. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

backfillMaterial.description: Property. Backfill material of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

beddingMaterial.description: Property. Bedding material of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

bulkCoeff.description: Property. Bulk reaction rate coefficient of the drainage pipe. Units:'E91'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

constructionMethod.description: Property. Construction method of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

criticalInfrastructure.description: Property. Whether the drainage pipe is critical infrastructure. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

crossSectionShape.description: Property. Cross-section shape of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

datasetResponsibleParty.description: Property. Party responsible for the dataset. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

designCapacity.description: Property. Designed flow capacity of the drainage pipe. Units:'MQS'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

diameter.description: Property. Diameter of the drainage pipe. Units:'MMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

dimension.description: Property. Cross-section dimensions of the drainage pipe. Units:'MMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

downstreamNetwork.description: Relationship. Downstream network connected to the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

drainagePipeType.description: Property. Type of drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

elevation.description: Property. Start and end elevation of the drainage pipe. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

endsAt.description: Relationship. End point of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

expectedLifespan.description: Property. Expected lifespan of the drainage pipe. Units:'ANN'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

externalCoating.description: Property. External coating of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

failureProbability.description: Property. Annual failure probability of the drainage pipe. Units:'C62'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

flow.description: Property. Current drainage flow of the drainage pipe. Units:'MQS'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

flowDirection.description: Property. Flow direction of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

floodZone.description: Property. Whether the drainage pipe is in a flood zone. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

groundwaterLevel.description: Property. Groundwater level around the drainage pipe. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

installationDate.description: Property. Installation date of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'

installationDepth.description: Property. Installation depth of the drainage pipe. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

internalLining.description: Property. Internal lining of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

jointType.description: Property. Joint type of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

lastCleaningDate.description: Property. Last cleaning date of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'

lastInspectionDate.description: Property. Last inspection date of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'

length.description: Property. Total length of the drainage pipe. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for maintaining the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

maintenanceSchedule.description: Property. Maintenance frequency of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

material.description: Property. Material of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

materialClass.description: Property. Material classification of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

maxAllowablePressure.description: Property. Maximum allowable pressure of the drainage pipe. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

operatingPressure.description: Property. Operating pressure of the drainage pipe. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

operator.description: Relationship. Operator of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

pressureClass.description: Property. Pressure class of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

pressurized.description: Property. Whether the drainage pipe is pressurized. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

quality.description: Property. Observed quality of the network component, from 1 to 5. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Unique URI identifying the network to which the component belongs. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

roughness.description: Property. Roughness coefficient of the drainage pipe. Units:'SM3'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

safetyNotes.description: Property. Safety notes of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

seismicZone.description: Property. Seismic zone of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

slope.description: Property. Slope of the drainage pipe. Units:'C62'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

soilCorrosivity.description: Property. Soil corrosivity around the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

startsAt.description: Relationship. Start point of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

status.description: Property. Operational status of the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

surroundingSoilType.description: Property. Soil type around the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency of data updates. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

upstreamNetwork.description: Relationship. Upstream network connected to the drainage pipe. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

velocityRange.description: Property. Flow velocity range of the drainage pipe. Units:'MTS'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

verticalGeometry.description: Property. Vertical geometry of the drainage pipe using 3D LineString coordinates. Model:'https://schema.org/GeoShape'

wallCoeff.description: Property. Wall reaction rate coefficient of the drainage pipe. Units:'RRC'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

wallThickness.description: Property. Wall thickness of the drainage pipe. Units:'MMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'
